sampling.planned_slots: Cartesian product of 5 windows, 5 predeclared dates each, and 2 publications: 50 dated issue slots; multiple editions for one date must all be counted, never selected by content
external_context_sources: TV Tupi 1963-11-07 script: date and source to be verified separately, excluded from newspaper baseline denominator
FBIS/Tupi 1963-11-08: index event, not a baseline issue
sampling.unit_of_count: One distinct newspaper article or broadcast item mentioning a fragment, irrespective of repetitions in the same item.
sampling.denominator: Number of entire newspaper pages actually inspected, plus accessible edition counts, reported for EACH date/publication/week; no inferred zeros for missing pages.
sampling.normalization: Unicode NFKD, strip combining accents, lowercase, collapse whitespace; literal tokens are only search leads, final counts require human confirmation of the full article/page and physical citation.
sampling.matching: For an anchor list, each element is mandatory and alternatives within an element are separated by |; same article context. Portuguese and English are separate channels and never treated as verbatim identical.
sampling.predefined_access_failure: For each date/publication try primary source PDF and its official viewer for the SAME issue only; HTTP 403/timeout/corrupt/unavailable => record specific failure and no observations. Do not replace date or vehicle after looking at outcomes.
sampling.predefined_reserve_week_rule: No opportunistic replacement weeks. If a baseline week has insufficient coverage, mark UNDETERMINED and report observed denominators; post-event December week is sensitivity only.
sampling.rate_definition: confirmed_articles_with_fragment / pages_actually_read, stratified by vehicle and week; do not turn unavailable into zero.
sampling.multiple_comparisons: Report all eight fragments and all negative matches. No significance threshold or posterior fixed in advance; label support conditional on coverage and independent chronology.

causal_scope.distinction: A phrase in another article may be coincidental; chronology and transmission channel are needed before H2/H3; absence only within pages inspected.
